DSPs are added and connected from the interface; the bridge remembers them.

Options:
  --port n                    HTTP port (8080 by default, or the PORT variable)
  --host address              listening address (0.0.0.0 by default: the whole local network)
  --pin code                  administrator code (otherwise everyone is administrator),
                              or the DSP_STUDIO_PIN variable
  --operator-pin code         operator code: volumes, mutes and preset recall only,
                              or the DSP_STUDIO_OPERATOR_PIN variable
  --data folder               remembered devices and library (~/.dsp-studio by default,
                              or the DSP_STUDIO_DATA variable)
  --web folder                compiled web interface (apps/web/dist by default)
  --cert file --key file
                              HTTPS (installable app, USB and serial in the browser)
  --allow-origin url          allows an interface hosted elsewhere (repeatable, * = all)
  --sandbox                   demo instance open to anyone: only the devices remembered
                              at start and demo DSPs can be reached,
                              or the DSP_STUDIO_SANDBOX=1 variable
  --quiet                     fewer messages
  -h, --help                  this help
